summary: Iteration 3 testing PASSED. Location cascade (loc-provinsi -> DKI Jakarta -> 5; loc-kabkota -> Kota Jakarta Selatan -> 2; loc-kecamatan -> Cilandak -> 1; loc-provinsi-clear -> 25). Favorites: tapping fav-card on 2 cards makes favorites-entry-button show '2'; /favorites lists both; tapping fav-card removes; empty state shows 'Belum ada favorit'. Public detail of the SOLD asset shows TERJUAL badge, sold-banner, sold-cta, similar-section (Aset Serupa) horizontal cards, fav-button, and whatsapp-button is NOT present; non-sold detail shows whatsapp-button, no sold-banner, and the 'Sudah Ada Jadwal Lelang' badge. Login page shows BSI logo image (not text). RCG admin (admin/Admin@2026): opened /detail/<published-id> -> mark-sold-button visible -> confirm-ok -> toast 'Asset ditandai terjual', status became 'Terjual', unmark-sold-button appeared -> unmark -> status back to 'Dipublikasikan'. Kelola -> manage-tab-laporan -> export-excel-button clicked; GET /api/rcg/reports/assets/link observed with HTTP 200. All SOLD test assets restored to PUBLISHED at end of run (per fixture cleanup) so demo dataset is untouched.
action_items: Optional: increase FlatList initialNumToRender or lower onEndReachedThreshold on Home; on web preview the inner scroll container is what fires onEndReached, and users tapping outside the list won't paginate. Not blocking (works when scrolling the list itself).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~1270 lines; still recommend router split (auth/marketing/acrm/rcg/admin/public/documents/wilayah/reports).

Similar-assets scoring is O(N) with an aggregation-friendly $match — fine for 25 demo assets but consider capping db.assets.find(q) with a limit and moving scoring to a $function or precomputed embedding when the catalog grows.
Excel report token has 10-min expiry but no revocation list; acceptable, but tokens remain valid if admin's session is invalidated. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Test temporarily marked one PUBLISHED asset as SOLD then restored it to PUBLISHED via /unsold in the fixture teardown. No demo data added/removed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env; login POST /api/auth/login {username,password}. TestIDs used in iter3: sold-badge-<id> (card overlay), sold-banner / sold-cta / similar-section / whatsapp-button / fav-button / fav-card-<id> / favorites-entry-button (badge count) / loc-provinsi | loc-kabkota | loc-kecamatan | loc-provinsi-clear / option-<name> (sheet options) / mark-sold-button / unmark-sold-button / confirm-ok / manage-tab-laporan / export-excel-button. Home FlatList: to trigger infinite pagination on web, scroll the inner container with overflowY auto (window scroll alone won't work). Sold flow endpoints: POST /api/rcg/assets/{id}/sold (body {notes}), POST /api/rcg/assets/{id}/unsold (no body). Excel: GET /api/rcg/reports/assets/link -> {url,expires_in}; follow with GET {BASE_URL}{url}. Public: /public/catalog (with is_sold sinking to end), /public/catalog/batch?ids=csv (order preserved, missing/invalid dropped), /public/catalog/{id}/similar (excludes id + SOLD).
rca_of_issue: No issues found. Initial observation of 'no TERJUAL overlay visible' turned out to be a test-scroll artifact — the RN Web FlatList uses its own inner scroll container, so scrolling window/body does not fire onEndReached / does not virtualize into last items. Scrolling the inner element rendered all 25 cards with 2 TERJUAL overlays at the tail as designed.
